name: dispatch
description: Plan before you fly — interview-driven specs you can execute. preflight captures what you want as INTENT.md before any solution is chosen; hop interviews, plans, and executes a small scope in one session; flightplan writes a multi-file blueprint (PLAN.md + tasks/) to disk; autopilot flies the tree with a dev→verify→judge→score quality loop and a closing final-review gate; waypoints orchestrates the rolling-wave roadmap tier above flightplan; deckplan is a reference-only guide to authoring Workflow scripts for flightdeck.
